releaseNotes: Listening Statistics adds private, on-device monthly summaries with qualified song plays, actual audible listening time, top artists and tracks, active days, and the busiest three-hour listening window. Library Health probable-duplicate results now let you compare every matching file, play the selected copy, keep it, or delete exactly that selected file through Android's confirmation flow. Duplicate detection remains probabilistic, and LocalWave never bulk-deletes or silently chooses a winner.
